scope: Logical source-service packet and SourceInstance association contract. RTL2.3-C5 implements only structural Chisel packet forwarding to the existing R4 parser; it does not implement source payload storage, attention arithmetic, R4 numeric merge, physical source mux, controller behavior, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU, end-to-end RTL correctness, or new A4 DSE.

child.name: route_a_source_service_packet_adapter
owns: hold exact accepted source packet association until R4 handshake
does_not_own: source plan discovery or source presence
payload storage or source attention computation
R4 numeric arithmetic or absent-source identity generation
consumer commit counting or source release
R6 merge request or attention terminal
authority transition metadata publication or page management

canonical_source_order.rule: the adapter accepts/offers source kinds only in this present-subset order for one accepted plan; this is merge-semantic order, not an execution schedule or arbitrary-reordering equivalence claim
canonical_source_order.consumer_order: unselected; consumer_id remains a distinct 0..3 owner/R4 association

accepted_plan_copy.rule: only an R6-accepted nonempty plan may be copied; adapter validates but never modifies it

source_packet_ingress.offer_rule: an offer is legal only from the sole owner of one present planned source instance; partial_present must be true and no absent source may offer
source_packet_ingress.present_fragment_rule: partial_present=true requires exactly fragments 0..7, with last true only at fragment 7
source_packet_ingress.absent_rule: the adapter does not synthesize an absent partial; R4 absent-source semantics remain governed by the frozen source_presence contract

r4_packet_egress.forwarding_rule: adapter forwards exact owner-provided header and data without mutation
structural_checks: absent header declares zero fragments and frozen absent identity

commit_release_association.commit_consumer: matching source owner through existing top demultiplexer
commit_release_association.rule: adapter does not consume ConsumerPartialCommit; matching source owner alone counts four distinct current-generation consumers and emits SourceRelease
commit_release_association.r6_rule: R6 alone compares exact SourceRelease instances with its nonempty accepted plan before merge_req

reject_without_mutation: source instance mismatch with accepted plan
rejection_and_stall.ready_low_rule: while an ingress or egress valid is high and its peer ready is low, every held identity, source instance, consumer, header, fragment, and data field remains unchanged; no source ownership, release, authority, or terminal state changes

excluded_paths: functional hot direct-pending or S2 payload storage
R6 merge request or outward terminal creation
authority transition metadata publication or page reclaim
physical source mux or service schedule

required_follow_on.requires: Implemented by RTL2.3-C5: protocol-only adapter, R6 accepted-plan copy, owner-provided packet ingress, and R4 header/sideband/fragment bindings. Directed coverage exercises all seven nonempty masks and stale/malformed/duplicate fail-closed cases; source arithmetic fault and source-service backpressure randomized coverage remain separate work.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: No payload backing, source attention arithmetic, R4 numeric implementation, source scheduler, physical mux, controller behavior, timing, throughput, PPA, or performance result.
